title: TensorPlate provisioning manifest
description: The trust root for `tensorplate bundle provision`: every file of every bundle it can provision, with the SHA-256 and size each file must have. Shipped by `tensorplate-cli` at /usr/share/tensorplate/provisioning/manifest.json. A provisioned bundle directory holds exactly these files, one of which is the bundle's own `manifest.json`, and nothing else. Beyond this schema, readers also require unique bundle names, unique file paths within a bundle, and a `manifest.json` file in every bundle.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint; readers ignore it.

name.description: What the operator names on the command line, and the directory the bundle is provisioned into under /var/lib/tensorplate/bundles/import/.

path.description: Relative path inside the bundle directory, `/`-separated, with no empty, `.` or `..` segment.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file's exact bytes.
